title: PAIOS Agent Policy
description: Ownership, boundaries, and lifecycle for a single governed agent. Enforced by the persona binder at execution time.

purpose.description: Statement of what the agent exists to do. Requests outside this purpose are out of scope for the agent regardless of the requester's entitlements.

owner.description: Accountable team or role. An agent without an owner cannot be governed and must not be routable.

allowed_users.description: Roles permitted to route work to this agent.

allowed_data_sources.description: Sources the agent may read. Intersected with the decision obligations at bind time; the narrower set wins.

restricted_actions.description: Actions the agent may never perform. Unioned with the decision obligations; a restriction here cannot be lifted by a rule.

approval_required_for.description: Actions that require human approval even when the request's risk level would otherwise permit execution.

review_cycle.description: How often the owner must re-attest to this policy.

retirement.description: A retired agent stops being routable but its audit history remains; retirement is a state change, not a deletion.
